newsitem.title: USA: CBOT corn sharply higher, fast, on fund buying.
newsitem.headline: CBOT corn sharply higher, fast, on fund buying.

text.p: CBOT corn futures were sharply higher late in trading with most contracts in fast dealings on heavy fund buying, traders said.
Friday's USDA cattle-on-feed report sparked gains early and fund buying continued the bullish trend, floor sources said. Funds bought at least 75 million bushels of corn on the day, traders said.
USDA Friday said the number of cattle placed on feed during January in the seven key feeding states in the U.S. was 25 percent above the placements during January a year ago.
Analysts were expecting the placmements figure to be 7.5 percent above a year ago.
At 1256 CST, corn was 4-3/4 to 9-1/2 cents per bushel higher with March up 8-1/2 at $2.82-1/2.
